Title: Fundamentals of Arc Welding Power(1)
Description: A foundational technical guide for Welder trade students explaining the principles of arc welding power sources, current types, and voltage characteristics required for stable arc control.

Title: Welding Machine Fundamentals(2)
Description: An essential training video for ITI Welder students introducing different types of welding machines, their core components, setting adjustments, and foundational operation principles.

Title: Principles of Welding Slope and Rotation(3)
Description: An essential technical session for Welder trade students explaining the principles of weld slope and rotation, and how these angles define different welding positions.

Title: Welding Symbols and Techniques(4)
Description: A foundational video for ITI Welder students explaining standard welding symbols, engineering drawing interpretations, and core joint fabrication techniques.

Title: Welding Arc Length(5)
Description: An essential technical session for Welder trade students explaining correct arc length control, its impact on weld quality, and how to maintain arc stability.

Title: Fundamentals of Polarity(6)
Description: An essential guide for Welder trade students explaining the principles of AC and DC currents, straight versus reverse polarity, and how electrode connection affects heat distribution and weld quality.
